name: Allegra J. Lawrence-Hardy
tagline: Top rated Employment & Labor attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
about: Allegra J. Lawrence-Hardy is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Atlanta, Georgia area. Providing legal representation in Georgia for a variety of different issues, Allegra Lawrence-Hardy was selected to Super Lawyers for 2004 - 2027.

After completing undergraduate studies, Allegra J. Lawrence-Hardy attended law school. Allegra Lawrence-Hardy was enrolled at Yale Law School. She earned a juris doctor degree in 1996. Allegra Lawrence-Hardy was admitted to the practice of law in 1998.

Attorneys like Allegra J. Lawrence-Hardy are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.
Allegra Lawrence-Hardy represents clients with Employment & Labor: Employer issues. Additional legal issues represented include Business Litigation.
